emberhold.name: Emberhold
emberhold.lore: Smoke never leaves the spires of Emberhold; every road in the Reach ends at its gates.

greyfen.name: Greyfen
greyfen.lore: Built on stilts above the mire, Greyfen runs on eels, peat and quiet bargains.

saltmarket.name: Saltmarket
saltmarket.sub: Harbour town of the Pale Coast
saltmarket.lore: Where the tide brings cargo and the cartels bring trouble; salt cures both.

thornwick.name: Thornwick
thornwick.lore: A ring of timber halls under the old briarwood, far from any road that matters.

oakhollow.name: Oakhollow
oakhollow.lore: Golden terraces and a single tavern; Oakhollow measures the year in harvests.

mudgate.name: Mudgate
mudgate.lore: Three shacks and a well at the meeting of roads. Most travellers don't stop.

crowfoot.name: Crowfoot
crowfoot.lore: Wind, gorse and crows. The kind of place you pass through with a hand on your purse.

ashenrest.name: Ashen Rest
ashenrest.lore: A shrine and a graveyard on the ash road north. People rest here. Some stay.
